animations.notes: Shopify themes commonly use scroll-reveal with opacity-0 class or stepped--hide (Dawn). Some themes load GSAP ScrollTrigger as a theme asset.

quirks.description: Shopify stores rarely reach Playwright's networkidle state due to persistent tracking scripts (trekkie, ShopifyAnalytics, web-pixels-manager, third-party apps).
quirks.workaround: Use domcontentloaded + explicit waitForTimeout(5000) instead of networkidle.

quirks.description: .shopify-section wrappers can be <div>, <section>, <header>, <footer>, or <aside> depending on the section's tag schema attribute.
quirks.workaround: Always select by .shopify-section class, never by tag name.

quirks.description: Cart drawers, modals, and geofencing overlays get .shopify-section class but are invisible. They appear as legitimate sections in DOM.
quirks.workaround: Filter out sections matching [id*='cart_drawer'], [id*='modal'], [id*='geofencing']. Check computed visibility/height.

quirks.description: Shopify's [data-section-id] attribute matches Squarespace detection, causing misidentification.
quirks.workaround: Check window.Shopify first to disambiguate. Shopify adapter should have higher priority than Squarespace.

quirks.description: Dawn-based themes wrap template sections inside main#MainContent > .content-container rather than making them direct main children.
quirks.workaround: Use .shopify-section as primary selector which bypasses nesting. Do not rely on main > * alone.

quirks.description: Many Shopify themes initialize sections with opacity: 0 and reveal on scroll via IntersectionObserver or ScrollTrigger.
quirks.workaround: Before extracting, inject script to force all opacity-0 / stepped--hide elements to full opacity.

quirks.description: Shopify Hydrogen/Oxygen stores have window.Shopify but zero .shopify-section elements. DOM is entirely custom React. CDN uses oxygen-v2/ path.
quirks.workaround: Detect Hydrogen by presence of window.Shopify + absence of .shopify-section. May need separate adapter.

quirks.description: Two CDN URL formats coexist: cdn.shopify.com/s/files/{store_id}/ (older) and {domain}/cdn/shop/files/ (newer proxy). Both serve the same images.
quirks.workaround: Match both patterns in cdnPatterns. Both support ?width= parameter for responsive sizing.

localSite.sectionSelector: body > header, body > nav, main > *, body > footer
